## Education

I'm a student double-majoring in Educational Studies and Psychological Science at Colgate University. My anticipated graduation date is May 2027. 

## Technical skills

* **Languages:** R
* **Tools:** Positron, Quarto, Git/GitHub, LaTeX

## Declaration of AI Use

In creating this website, I used Large Language Models:

* As a replacement of search tools (e.g., Google)

* To identify errors (e.g., Where is the error in this code chunk/logic? My website is not updated even though my repository is---where can the problem be?)

* To trouble-shoot errors (e.g., How can I debug this?)

* To clarify conceptual problems (e.g., Why are the bars in the PDF "stacked" on each other in the CDF? In plain language, why do we use effect size in power analysis to identify sample size?)

* To check clarity and grammar of writing

* To criticize/evaluate my output.
